blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has apologised to Malaysia and Singapore over a toxic haze caused by rampant wildfires in his country that polluted the skies of Indonesia’s neighbours. The months-long blazes on Borneo, Sumatra and Papua islands razed vast tracts of land and produced air pollution that sickened hundreds of thousands at home and drifted across borders to Malaysia and Singapore.
